description: This file defines the Loader class in the OpenCart system, responsible for dynamically loading controllers, models, views, libraries, configurations, helpers, and handling method calls via proxies and regular expressions.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A class responsible for dynamically loading and managing controllers, models, views, libraries, configurations, and helpers within the OpenCart framework, with mechanisms for event triggers and proxies for method calls.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Loader with a Registry instance.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Overloads property access to retrieve objects from the registry.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Overloads property setting to store objects in the registry.

methods.name: controller
methods.description: Loads a controller class based on the route and executes its method with arguments, after sanitizing and triggering pre/post events.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Loads a model class based on the route, wraps it in a proxy, and stores it in the registry.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Renders a view template with data, triggering pre/post events.

methods.name: language
methods.description: Loads language data for a route, with event triggers.

methods.name: library
methods.description: Loads a library class, stores it in the registry, and returns the object.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Loads configuration data for a route, with event triggers.

methods.name: helper
methods.description: Includes helper PHP files from system or extension directories.

methods.name: callback
methods.description: Creates a callable that loads a model, invokes a method, and triggers events, used as a proxy for model method calls.
